theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_integer_median
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → μ F = ENNReal.ofReal a → Measurable u → (∀ x, ∃ k : ℤ, u x = k) → IntegrableOn u F μ → ∃ β : ℤ, ENNReal.ofReal (|(β : ℝ)| * a) ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x| ∂μ ∧ (β ≠ 0 → μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≠ 0}) ≠ 0) ∧ ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - β| ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in F, ∫⁻ y in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ∂μ ∂μ
